run_migrate_checkpoint_cli: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI to convert an OCP checkpoint to the fm_release format with updated imports
run_migrate_checkpoint_add_stress: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI with --add-stress to automatically add stress tasks for datasets missing them
migrate_checkpoint_function: migrate a PyTorch checkpoint by updating module imports, configs, and optionally adding stress tasks
update_config_function: recursively update a config dict or OmegaConf object by replacing old module paths with new mapped names
generate_stress_task_config_function: generate a stress task configuration dict with DDPMTLoss, normalizer, and dataset settings for a given RMSD
